title: "The One Ring Should Not Be Destroyed"
subtitle: A joint press release from Sauron, the Lord of the Rings, and Gollum, former Ring Bearer
text:
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

MORDOR, MIDDLE-EARTH - May 12, 2023

“As Ring bearers, both the wretched creature Gollum and the Lord of the Rings, Sauron, are shocked by the announcement made by OptumInsights regarding the One Ring.”

“Mr. Sauron and Mr. Gollum were on opposite sides of the middle-earth-wide debate regarding the Ring. Despite our deeply help beliefs about to whom the “precious,” as both privately called the One Ring, belonged, today we stand united. We stand against a shocking and reckless decision announced by Optum, a wholly owned subsidiary of UnitedHealth Group. We both believe the One Ring is not best thrown into the fiery chasms of the Fife.”

“This was not our understanding of the intentions the series D Round led by Optum Ventures in Mordor Inc. Futher, we believe that OV is in breach of its fiduciary responsibility as the leader of that round. Series B and C leads General Catalyst, a16z Bio, and the rest of our investors who supported the development of the One Ring platform for all these years deserve better,” The voice of Sauron dutifully reported.

“Since the forging of the rings of power, and the founding of Mordor, Inc. By Sauron, as a “stealth mode” Solo-prenure; One Ring has been better than many. Sauron understood his disruptive platform solution, the One Ring, is more than a symbol of power.

Share The Frontier Psychiatrists

It was launched to aggregate the fractured Power-Ring Space. He brought One solution to market. It was not an easy “go-to-middle-earth” motion. Search is a difficult market. Ring Search might as well be a new Maps product plus a search engine! However, our team relentlessly executed. Its preciousness extends beyond its intrinsic value, symbolizing the rich history and ability to cross into the wraith world invisibly. Its loss would not just ours, but that of all ring bearers of Middle-Earth. UnitedHealth Group does not take into account the impact on all other ring bearers on its careless destruction—their power is tied to it! They too will fade.” Stated G. Wormtongue, SVP Strategy, Mordor Inc.

“Optum, Inc.'s decision to cast the One Ring into the fires of Mount Doom is a direct attack on our cultural and corporate heritage, and destroyed valuable IP. We believe this move to be short-sighted, unnecessary, and a clear sign of a lack of respect for the history and values that Mordor, Inc. has always represented.” The Voice of Sauron dutifully relayed.

Gollum, former Keeper of the One Ring, adds, "Precious, our precious was taken. Bad Optum, very bad! They throws it away, they does, right into the nasty fire. Gollum! We must saves it, we must! Auctioned the IP instead of destroying it, they should have!”

In agreement, the Witch King of Angmar voiced his concern: "…(silence)…(menacing silence)…."

Sauron, Gollum, the Witch King of Angmar, stand with all elves and Men, and urgently appeal to the wider community of Middle-Earth to raise their voices against this corporate vandalism. We believe in the right of all businesses to protect their legacies and the symbols that represent them. Today, it is the One Ring; tomorrow, it could be the Historic Shire.

We urge Optum, UHG, and the Board to reconsider their decision, and we call on all other corporate entities to respect the histories and values of the companies they acquire. Let this not be a precedent for the destruction of culturally relevant innovations.

Reached for Comment, Elven Ring Bearer Gandalf the White stated, “This proposed resolution shall not pass.”
